verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an ML/GPU cloud platform, but the evidence only describes Paperspace as a hosted service: cloud VMs, notebooks, deployments, and workflows managed through its console, API, and CLI. Root SSH access to rented VMs is not the same as self-hosting the platform. The marketing even positions Paperspace as an alternative to buying your own servers, and nothing documents an on-prem or self-hosted edition.
